## Weidenbaum Center Events I Host {.section-title}

The Weidenbaum Center convenes scholars, policymakers, students, and public audiences through talks, panels, and policy discussions. These recordings highlight current debates in governance, economics, and democratic institutions.

[Visit the Weidenbaum Center Channel](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvJOmn5O0jvtON27hM5GXew){.btn .btn-outline target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"}
